title.en: Present state, next state preview and clock commit

summary: Verify that state changes only at clock events, that transitions cover every state and input pair, and that traces replay.
objective: Present state is unchanged between clock events, every state and input pair has exactly one transition, and repeated runs match.
applies_when: A machine distinguishes present state from a previewed next state.
A clock, step or commit control advances the machine.
Inputs can change between clock events.
intent_signals: the state changed before I clocked it
check the transition table is complete
example_prompts: Check the clocked transitions of this state machine scene.

principles: Present state and next state are different variables, so a preview must never be written into the present state before the clock event; a legal self-loop makes them equal in value while still being a committed transition.
Determinism requires a total transition function: exactly one transition for every state and input pair, checked as coverage rather than assumed from a diagram.
Replay is the observable of determinism, so the same initial state and input sequence must produce the same trace every time.
implementation: Enumerate the product of states and inputs and confirm exactly one transition per pair, listing any pair with none or several.
Change inputs repeatedly without clocking, recording present state after each change, then clock once and record the selected transition, the committed present state and whether it was a self-loop.
Run a fixed input sequence twice from the same initial state and compare traces step by step, including outputs.
Include an input change coinciding with the clock event and record the declared rule that resolves the coincidence.
observable_checks: Every state and input pair has exactly one transition, and a missing pair is reported rather than silently defaulting to staying in place.

Present state is unchanged by input edits between clock events, and each clock event selects and commits exactly one transition; on a self-loop the committed value equals the previous one, which is a correct commit rather than a missed one.
Two runs of the same sequence produce identical traces, and the coincident-edge case follows the declared rule rather than varying between runs.

known_limits: Covers a declared synchronous deterministic machine; metastability, asynchronous inputs and synthesis are outside this check.
Authored verification guidance; no machine was run for this record.
creative_affordances: Adapt the scenario, scale and presentation to your subject; this record fixes what must be checked, not how the scene must look.

claims.statement: In a well-formed state transition diagram the transitions leaving each state are mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive, so exactly one transition is selected for each combination of current state and input, and a rising clock edge triggers the move to the next state.
claims.scope: Synchronous deterministic finite state machines as described in the cited section.
